text:
Nina: Flagging invoice RWI-4620 — Bill shows a $90,000 prepaid Dedicated charge for Oct 16 - Nov 30 but our GL extract posted full amount to Revenue (4001) on Oct 16. That will inflate Oct revenue unless we defer/prorate.
Carlos: Can you confirm service dates on contract? looks like a partial-month start.
Nina: Contract ID BETA-2025-DED dates are 2025-10-16 through 2025-11-30. Sales indicated prorate by days.
Shiv: Ok, quick math: total period = 46 days (inclusive). Oct 16-31 = 16 days, Nov = 30 days. Prorated amounts: Oct = 90k * 16/46 = 31,304.35, Nov = 90k * 30/46 = 58,695.65. We'll need deferral entries to move to 2190 and then recognize per those prorated figures.
Nina: Can you post the exact JE lines we want AP to use? AP asked to avoid cents if possible.
Carlos: Draft JEs: (post reversing JE to correct the mis-post on 2025-10-16)
```
DR Sales Revenue (GL 4001): 90,000
CR Deferred Revenue (GL 2190): 90,000
```
Then recognition (post on 2025-10-31 and 2025-11-30):
```
2025-10-31 DR Deferred Revenue (2190): 31,304.35  CR Sales Revenue (4001): 31,304.35
2025-11-30 DR Deferred Revenue (2190): 58,695.65  CR Sales Revenue (4001): 58,695.65
```
Note: Round to nearest dollar if your system requires. Include contract and invoice refs in description.
rev-bot: Auto-note: Invoice RWI-4620 flagged for manual revenue schedule assignment. Ticket #RWI-ACC-905 created.
AP-team: Quick Q 1: Should AP post first to a suspense/clearing account (2100) then move to 2190? Our process usually uses suspense for external remapped invoices.
Shiv: For speed, post directly to 2190 with the JE description: "RWI-4620 / BETA-2025-DED prorated deferral". Avoid suspense unless matching issues prevent posting.
Nina: Metadata for ticket: external_invoice=RWI-4620, contract=BETA-2025-DED, rev_schedule=REV-SCH-PROR-2025-10, periods=[2025-10,2025-11], JE_owner=accounting-ops. Adding that to the ticket now.
Carlos: Approvals: amount < $100k? Wait it's $90k so falls under finance manager sign-off only. @Shiv can you approve?
Shiv: Approved. Please ensure billing mapping bug is filed. This looks like the invoice type "Prepaid Dedicated - prorated" isn't recognized by the ETL mapping so it defaulted to Revenue.
Nina: Filing mapping request with Billing Eng: will add sample invoice, CSV extract and expected GL mapping (2190).
Carlos: @Nina please ask eng to include a unit test for the parser that covers start-date inside month cases.
Nina: Will do. AP-team: once JE posted, reply here with JE number so I can close the ticket.
AP-team: Will post today. Tentative JE ref: JE-2025-1029-77.
rev-bot: Update: Ticket RWI-ACC-905 status changed to "awaiting-ETL-refresh" at 2025-10-17T09:05:00Z.
Nina: Thanks all 1 - I'll check monthly revenue report after ETL and confirm the reclassification reflected.
